hooks.command: diff -q "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/package.json" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/package.json" >/dev/null 2>&1 || (mkdir -p "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/data" && printf '{"state":"installing","at":%s000}' "$(date +%s)" > "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/data/warmup.json"; cd "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}" && cp "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/package.json" . && npm install --no-fund --no-audit) || rm -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/package.json"; CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}" NODE_PATH="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/node_modules" node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/gap-nudge.cjs" --prefetch
